create_circular_shift_bijector: create a CircularShift bijector to shift values with wrapping around a torus between lower and upper bounds
create_rescale_bijector: create a Rescale bijector to linearly rescale values from one range to another range
use_circular_shift_forward: use the CircularShift forward method to apply a wrapped shift transformation to input values
use_circular_shift_inverse: use the CircularShift inverse method to reverse a wrapped shift transformation on output values
use_rescale_transform: use the Rescale bijector to transform values from an input range to an output range via ScalarAffine
